ai_summary: Afcons Infrastructure Limited has received a favorable arbitration award of ₹335.50 Crores against the Uttar Pradesh Expressways Industrial Development Authority (UPEIDA), which includes a significant portion of pre-award and pendente lite interest. This award is expected to have a positive material impact on the company's financial position. However, the realization of this amount is subject to the counterparty not challenging the award within the legally prescribed period, presenting a potential uncertainty or delay.
